product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Computer Case CPU Holder Thin Client Mini PC Multi-Mount
product.description: Free up valuable desk space and get a clutter‑free workstation by moving your mini PC out of the way! Attach it under your desk, secure it on your monitor mount, or bolt it directly to your monitor's VESA® attachment with the help of this computer mount.This mount gives your computer case a home that is secure, out of the way, but still within easy reach. It works particularly well with sit‑stand desks, allowing the computer case to move with your height‑adjustable workstation while keeping cables and connections attached and organized.
